summary: Remove the vulnerable braces build dependency and upgrade the Spanner SDK to eliminate vulnerable OpenTelemetry dependencies from the backend.

instructions: Build from the frozen workspace lockfile or consume the qualified updated backend image to use Spanner SDK 9.1 and OpenTelemetry 2.x.

configuration: Backend build commands and supported runtime configuration retain their existing interfaces.

changes: The shared package optional Spanner peer range accepts SDK 9.1 alongside 8.x; HTTP APIs and configuration schemas are unchanged.

notes: The frozen bootstrap predecessor, migration inventory and schema-plan identities are unchanged.

security: Remove tsc-alias and its transitive braces 3.0.3 dependency, affected by CVE-2026-93687 (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm), without suppressing the advisory.
The braces package was a build dependency and absent from the production dependency graph and both v0.31.0 Oracle image SBOMs.

Upgrade the Spanner SDK from 8.11.0 to 9.1.0 with its required Google SDK and OpenTelemetry family to remove OpenTelemetry core 1.30.1, affected by CVE-2026-54285 (GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf), from production dependencies.
knownLimitations: Published artifacts and GitHub's default-branch dependency alert change only after this repair is shipped and the applicable artifacts are published.
Protected CI, native AMD64 image acceptance and selected cross-database/browser gates remain required before merge; local Spanner evidence uses the emulator.
rollback: Reverting the build-tool change restores the vulnerable development dependency and requires a security assessment.
Reverting the production SDK upgrade restores the old OpenTelemetry dependency and requires a security assessment; no schema rollback is needed.
validation: Seven executable resolver fixtures passed, including literal wildcard filename substitution; compiled comparison of 744 emitted files retained the same module targets and application code.
All 3,850 backend and 1,567 frontend unit tests passed; backend and frontend-host typechecks, lint and packed host-package runtime checks passed.
PostgreSQL and Spanner emulator 1.5.30 each passed seven stages and six populated upgrade baselines. Live Google Cloud Spanner acceptance remains separate.
The frozen bootstrap image passed its PostgreSQL 16 bootstrap, idempotence, receipt and drift rejection checks with the refreshed production dependencies.
Frozen dependency installation, peer validation and npm audit passed with zero advisories.

Native ARM64 standard backend, Oracle and bootstrap images passed the pinned Trivy 0.72.0 all-severity gate with zero vulnerabilities; actual image dependency checks confirmed Spanner 9.1, absent vulnerable packages and capped incoming baggage.

Release-note tooling, package version discipline, documentation boundary, license checks and 184 CI contracts passed. The optional peer boundary requires build and production to use the same explicit supported peer alternative while preserving the public Spanner 8.x/9.1 range.
